- PayPal 限制账户可扣留余额最多 180 天｜PayPal User Agreement「Actions We May Take if You Engage in Any Restricted Activities」（2026-09-14 更新，2026-10-31 查阅）：称可 hold Balance Account / business account 余额 ==up to 180 days==（合理保护负债风险或违反 Acceptable Use Policy）；另写 hold 可因法院令/监管要求等超过 180 天 https://www.paypal.com/us/legalhub/paypal/useragreement-full
- Capital One Refer a Friend 推荐办卡奖励｜Capital One Help Center「Credit card referral bonuses」（2026-10-31 查阅）：主卡持卡人通过唯一推荐链接，朋友获批开户后可获推荐奖励；奖金自动入账，最多约 ==8== 周；有年封顶，具体金额以账户内展示为准 https://www.capitalone.com/help-center/credit-cards/getting-credit-card-referral-bonus/
